lines: {name}. You came. Sit down. Or don't, you'll only fidget, you always fidget.
Right. Everyone in this town calls me the professor and nobody says of what.
Movement. That's of what. Not battling, not breeding. Where things go.
And more to the point, why they all decide to go at the same time.
Every seventy years the Caeloran Sea turns over and the whole region gets up and walks.
We call it the Turning. Ours isn't due for another eleven years.
It started four months ago.
No, I don't know why. That is rather the shape of the problem.
I can't walk the region any more. My knees have opinions and they hold them firmly.
So I'm asking you to walk it for me, and write down what you see.
You'll want company. Go on, they've been awake since I lit the lamp.
Good. Look after each other, and I do mean that in both directions.
Here. The Vellum. It fills itself in as you go. More or less.
The more or less is why I need a person out there and not a book.
You received the Vellum, 5 Field Vessels and 3 Potions.
Ashgate's north up Route 1. Ask for Tirren's sister at the Kin Clinic, she owes me.
And {name} — anything out there that's somewhere it has no business being...
Write it down. Even the dull ones. Especially the dull ones.
He's been awake two days pinning those charts. Two.
Have a look before you go. The arrows all point inward.
They've never pointed inward. Not in any year he's got up on that wall.
Here, take these. He'll only lose them. He loses everything but the charts.
You received 3 Tonic Berries.
